target_claim: For each partition P, the lower Darboux sum satisfies L(λf+μg,P)=λL(f,P)+μL(g,P).
source_quote: Because this identity is preserved for all possible partitions of $\closedint a b$, it is preserved for the supremum and infimum of all possible [[Definition:Lower Darboux Sum|lower Darboux sums]] and [[Definition:Upper Darboux Sum|upper Darboux sums]], so the linear combinations of $f$ and $g$ are integrable.
